gen-dafont-nordic-gf-khula: Nordic is cramped and ancient, its single-weight strokes spaced like brush dabs. Khula, with its generous midsection and curves that keep their mouths open, would keep paragraphs flowing smoothly line after line.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-krub: Krub has a pronounced x-height, its curves leaving loops unfinished. Nordic is best at ancient power through closed, cramped letters, while the body is best at open, contemporary ease.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-kufam: Powerful and ancient, Nordic holds its closed letters apart like brush dabs on paper. Kufam runs a single track width like neon tubing, its curves in e generously open and its bodies dominating the line.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-lexend: Ancient and powerful, Nordic hunches into closed shapes spaced like brush dabs. Lexend brings outsized lowercase and curves with open jaws, so the two pull in opposite directions on the page.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-mada: Scattered brush dabs, pressed shut: that is Nordic, with a constant-width pen line. And Mada leaves its curves unclosed, with a towering midzone that keeps the whole page feeling approachable and modern.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-miriam-libre: Powerful and ancient, Nordic keeps its letters cramped shut. Miriam Libre draws a wire-weight line with generous openings in the s, so paragraphs move along with lowercase of cast-iron stature.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-montserrat-underlin: Montserrat Underline breathes through counters like a cut hollow reed. Nordic is best at ancient power through closed, cramped letters, while the body is best at oversized lowercase beside its own capitals.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-mozilla-text: Nordic has stems like dowels and arcs like bent dowels, pressed shut and ancient. But Mozilla Text, with towering bodies that make its lowercase look bold and terminals that flare outward, stands in sharp contrast.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Powerful and ancient, Nordic frames its counters with uniform strokes and spaces its letters like brush dabs. Noto Kufi Arabic leaves a welcoming gap in its c and keeps capitals barely above lowercase, a modern, clean foil.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads clean and contemporary, keeping its curve endings well apart and its lowercase c, s and z full. Under Nordic, long paragraphs would stay light and open.
